description: Points a subdomain (for example go.yourcompany.com) at the Monetize platform so the proposition's app and landing pages are served on the customer's own domain. The subdomain is supplied via the host parameter; the target is the Railway hostname issued for that domain.
variableDescription: %target%: the platform hostname the subdomain must point to (xxxx.up.railway.app), issued per domain when it is connected in Monetize.
